Week 28 Module Map: Populism and Progressivism

Quarter 4: Convergence and Divergence

Texas does not just join the national Populist movement. Lampasas County is one of the places it began.

Your lessons this week

  • Lesson 1: The Farmers' Alliance and the Populist Revolt
  • Lesson 2: Governor Hogg and the Progressive Turn

What to turn in

  • Reading quiz: Week 28 Reading Quiz
  • Primary source assessment: Week 28 Primary Source Assessment
  • VR write-up: Week 28 VR Write-Up, based on your immersive session

Keep going all quarter

Read each lesson all the way through before you start the quiz. The read-aloud player at the top of each lesson can help you follow along, and the speaker button next to each vocabulary word plays its pronunciation.

Something to watch for

Service: notice it in the Alliance members who worked together, in Governor Hogg, and in Jane McCallum and the suffragists.
